headline: Takagi Seiko Corporation Updates on Ransomware Incident
body: In a follow-up to its recent cybersecurity breach, Takagi Seiko Corporation has provided additional details about the ransomware attack. The automotive components supplier confirmed that the attackers accessed sensitive internal data months before the breach was discovered. Takagi Seiko Corporation has assured that its operations were not disrupted and that affected individuals have been notified. Incident response teams are actively working to mitigate any further risk and secure the company's systems.
